item.title: Mark Your Calendar! Martin Cleaners Opening March 16 in Magee
item.description: A long-awaited service is finally returning to Simpson County. Beginning Monday, March 16, Martin Cleaners will officially open its doors in Magee, bringing convenient dry-cleaning services back to the community. Martin Cleaners is a well-established business with a long history of serving customers. Founded in 1947, the company currently operates locations in Florence and Byram.
